scope: Reviewed inventory delta: the complete contribution groups (code COMDAT, associative .debug$F, section definitions and symbols inside) of the two unaccepted definitions _eng1_02500 and _eng1_02d80 change to the pinned contents; no function is added or removed; every other section, symbol, auxiliary record and relocation stays identical; every accepted contribution of the unit (ENG1 and ENG3 rows of the one /O2 object) stays byte-, flag- and ordered-relocation identical. No acceptance of pending functions.

rationale._eng1_02d80: Lane solKEY source form: the complete fresh contribution becomes relocation-masked equal to ENG1 0x2d80 (432 bytes), which is staged as the new masked row eng1.02d80.

method: Canonical and candidate unit compiled once each with the pinned VC5 toolchain; the declaration lists every defined function whose contribution group digest differs (FILE records compared path-normalized); checked with check_delta of reviewed-unit-delta-v3 with every accepted peer protected, and refused when a change is undeclared, a pin is wrong, one masked or accepted byte is mutated, or v2 is used.
